title: SearchBox improvements
body:
Search should implement an easily identifiable input with the ability to clear the query.

Changes needed:
 - follow the same patterns as in http://shipow.github.io/searchbox/
 - provide a clear function in the connector
 - have templates for the magnifying glass (identifying the search field) and the cross (button to clear the query)

[Example on react-instantsearch](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/storybook/?selectedKind=SearchBox&selectedStory=default&full=0&down=1&left=1&panelRight=1&downPanel=storybooks%2Fstorybook-addon-knobs)
